Train a normalised-conformal calibration for a Cubist + PCA model

Source: R/conformal.R
train_normalized_conformal.Rd

Mirrors the Safanelli 2025 procedure (eqs. 9-10):

  1. Cross-validated predictions \(\hat{y}_i^{CV}\) on the training set via internal k-fold CV (Safanelli: "Cross-validated predictions were also used to estimate the unbiased absolute error", p.10)

  2. Compute absolute residuals \(\delta_i = |y_i - \hat{y}_i^{CV}|\)

  3. Train an error model with the SAME architecture (Cubist on the same PC scores) that maps PC scores to \(\delta_i\)

  4. Compute non-conformity scores \(\alpha_i = \delta_i / \hat{\delta}_i\)

  5. Store the confidence-th quantile of \(\alpha_i\)

Usage

train_normalized_conformal(
  pca,
  response_model,
  X_train,
  y_train,
  confidence = 0.68,
  committees = NULL,
  k_cv = 5L,
  conformal_subset_n = 10000L,
  seed = 42L
)

Arguments

pca

Fitted PCA list (from .fit_pca())

response_model

Cubist model trained on pca$scores

X_train

Preprocessed TRAINING spectra used to fit response_model

y_train

Numeric vector of training targets

confidence

Confidence level (default 0.68 = ~1 SD per Safanelli)

committees

Cubist committees for the error model (default = same as response model when retrievable, else 5)

k_cv

Folds used to obtain CV residuals on the training set (default 5)

conformal_subset_n

Cap on how many training samples feed the inner CV that produces the residuals (default 10000). Calibration only needs a stable quantile, so a subsample avoids refitting the full training set k_cv times.

seed

RNG seed

Value

List with error_model, alpha_q, confidence
